categories.main_business_segments: Anhui Conch Cement Company Limited primarily operates in the production and sales of cement, clinker, aggregates, and concrete. The company also extends into related industries such as new energy, environmental protection, digital industries, and building materials. It has a comprehensive product range including various grades of cement widely used in infrastructure projects, real estate development, and rural markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced cement production technologies including low-energy, deep-cold direct oxygen combustion for clinker production and SCR denitrification technology for emission reduction. It integrates digital and green low-carbon technologies into its manufacturing processes, emphasizing energy efficiency, emission control, and the use of alternative fuels. The company also invests in R&D for innovative materials and intelligent production systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large infrastructure construction projects such as railways, highways, airports, and water conservancy, as well as urban real estate developers, cement product manufacturers, and rural construction markets. The company serves both domestic Chinese markets and international markets in Asia, Africa, and South America.
categories.geographic_coverage: Anhui Conch Cement operates extensively across China, covering eastern, central, southern, and western regions with a strong presence in major provinces. It also has significant overseas operations with subsidiaries and projects in countries including Indonesia, Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Russia, and Uzbekistan. The company maintains over 500 market departments domestically and abroad.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the cement supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and sales of cement and related products. It also extends upstream into raw material mining and downstream into concrete and building materials production, as well as logistics and supply chain services through affiliated companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the core cement business while advancing digital transformation, green and low-carbon technologies, and expanding new energy and environmental protection industries. R&D focuses on energy-saving technologies, emission reduction, intelligent manufacturing, new materials development, and sustainable production methods. The company actively pursues innovation as a driver for high-quality growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of cement, clinker, aggregates, and concrete. Additional income streams include service revenues from logistics, construction, and environmental services, as well as investment income from equity holdings and financial products. The company also receives government subsidies related to environmental and energy-saving initiatives.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Anhui Conch Cement is a leading player in the Chinese cement industry with a strong brand and extensive market network. It competes with other major cement producers such as West China Cement, Huaxin Cement, and Jilin Yatai Group. The company maintains a competitive edge through technological innovation, cost control, and integrated supply chain management.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 91 billion in 2024, a decline from the previous year due to market contraction. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 7.7 billion. Total assets reached RMB 254.6 billion with steady growth in asset base and capital expenditures focused on capacity expansion and technological upgrades. The company has a large workforce of nearly 50,000 employees.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Anhui Conch Cement emphasizes high-quality products with a broad range of cement grades tailored for diverse infrastructure and construction needs. Its competitive differentiation lies in advanced manufacturing technologies, strong R&D capabilities, integrated supply chain and logistics services, and commitment to environmental sustainability and low-carbon production. The company offers comprehensive product solutions and maintains a robust market presence domestically and internationally.
